name: app-catalog-store
title: Application Catalog & Homelab App Store
description: Deploy open-source homelab applications (Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Ollama, Triton, CUDA workloads) from transparent OCI registry catalogs into your Bluefin Server home control plane using GitOps or direct in-cluster execution.
author: Project Bluefin lab
prerequisites: KubeStellar and KubeStellar Console running on the cluster
Argo Workflows installed in the argo namespace

steps.title: Inspect in-cluster catalog provider indexes
steps.description: The lab cluster maintains thin OCI index files refreshed by CronWorkflows: linuxserver.json (~200 homelab media/server apps) and ngc.json (~725 official NVIDIA AI/GPU containers).
steps.command: python3 -c "import json, glob; [print(f, len(json.load(open(f)).get('apps', []))) for f in glob.glob('docs/data/catalog/*.json') if not f.endswith('installed.json')]"

steps.title: Check currently installed catalog apps
steps.description: View the list of open-source homelab applications currently installed and tracked in the cluster.

steps.title: Submit a GitOps app install (default)
steps.description: Triggers the in-cluster catalog-install-lsio WorkflowTemplate. This fetches upstream app config, applies lab storage/security policies, renders Kubernetes manifests, and opens a GitOps PR for review.
steps.command: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/catalog-install-lsio -p app=jellyfin -p mode=gitops -n argo --watch

steps.title: Submit an imperative app install (direct apply)
steps.description: For immediate execution without waiting for PR review: renders manifests, runs offline structural validation, applies directly to the cluster, and records the installation.
steps.command: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/catalog-install-lsio -p app=jellyfin -p mode=imperative -n argo --watch

steps.title: Verify installed app health and CVE scans
steps.description: Installed catalog apps run under their designated namespaces (e.g. catalog-jellyfin). Nightly CronWorkflows scan installed workloads with Grype and output display-only CVE summaries.
steps.command: kubectl get pods,svc,pvc -n catalog-jellyfin && cat docs/data/catalog/installed-scans.json

troubleshooting.title: Workflow submission fails on resource quota
troubleshooting.description: Ensure the workflow pod spec includes explicit requests and limits for CPU, memory, and ephemeral-storage.
troubleshooting.command: kubectl get resourcequota argo-quota -n argo -o yaml

troubleshooting.title: App image pull error from upstream registry
troubleshooting.description: Check that the zot-cache pull-through registry mirror is running and that the upstream registry (lscr.io, nvcr.io) is listed in the allowlist.
